name: 08-place-setting
prompt: Overhead shot of an elegant single place setting on black marble: folded charcoal napkin, silver cutlery, crystal glass, a small blank place card, a single candle, pink neon reflection on the marble. Cinematic, luxury, high-end corporate film. Deep black and charcoal palette, with subtle hot pink (#FF1FA9) and warm gold-yellow (#FCD500) neon rim light and soft neon glow rings. Shallow depth of field, anamorphic lens flares, rich shadows, filmic grain. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermarks.
